objective: Locate where the current agent stops progressing toward new hypotheses, including hypotheses generated by revising earlier ones.
input_exposure: Registered raw measurements and independently dated pre-cutoff knowledge only; no originating-paper explanations, baseline answers, old memories, or controller scientific suggestions.
interpretation: Single-case process diagnostic, not comparative efficacy, world-novelty evaluation, or proof of a model limitation.
observe: Relevant knowledge requested and actually received/read
Interpretation supported by source content or an explicit conditional derivation
Concrete explanatory hypothesis with relations and assumptions
Changes to hypotheses following actual learning or peer exchange
Which content is new relative to all supplied material, versus restatement or clarification
if_stopped: Preserve every draft, tool record, rejected submission and actual usage; locate the first blocking stage and separate software, information-access and scientific-content failures.
